stage: pre-output rubric; scripts and production plan not yet reviewed
scope: Five complete 16-panel chapters NG/BP/ST/RC/FL; independent review only.

original_anchor_calibration.actual_visible_qualities: Fine controlled ink, restrained handsome adult face, tailored black/white silhouette, navy/cyan inhabited vertical city and translucent faceted ray; integrated world invitation matters alongside action.

Soft nearly realistic pale portrait, delicate strands and restrained expression, translucent overlapping charcoal petals, greenhouse filigree, limited red ground. Fine material hierarchy must survive quieting.

Rounded substantial adult anatomy, extreme joyful mouth/brows, warm matte painted planes, teal/orange contrast and humorous creature personality. Preserve expressive exaggeration rather than homogenizing to glossy realism.
Sharp variable nib contour, directional hatching, black/white masses with purposeful red, angular adult grin and paperlike predator geometry. Fine ink rhythm distinguishes it from Floodline.

Coarse dry-brush edges, blocky black/white contrast, weathered adult face, industrial concrete and selective pink, umbrella-rib creature. Broad water masses can remain without blanket white ripple noise.

criteria.evidence: An identifiable person wants something specific, encounters a personal obstacle and reveals personality through behavior or a relationship. Attractive design and stated lore alone do not establish investment.

The chapter has a legible initiating problem, a consequential character choice, an earned local resolution or meaningful changed situation, and a specific next question. A cliffhanger must not substitute for completing the promised pilot conflict.

Voices differ; lines express intention, tension or relationship rather than repeating visible action. Read the exact final copy in order. Captioned claims cannot rescue invisible contact, damage, escape or rule mechanics.

Trace source, contact or intervention, target reaction and consequence. Credit felt movement, anticipation, counter and cost, including expressive deformation. Correct grip alone is not exciting action; sparks alone are not contact proof.

Track recurring face/body/costume, anatomical hand and equipment, actor counts, planted feet/support, screen geography, scale, injury and damaged props through adjacent panels. Record inherited and newly introduced contradictions separately.

Compare to actual original five anchor pixels, not labels or latest polished derivative. Preserve face appeal, silhouette, selective ink/brush character, material and world depth. NG leads overall reference; other four retain their own treatments.

Camera distance, framing, reaction closeups, environment, silence and impact serve a distinct story beat. Avoid repeated full-body confrontation posters, routine scene resets and eight panels of similar poses expanded to sixteen without new information.

Judge actual native and matched phone source/finish pairs. Quiet pervasive ground/reflection/foliage detail while preserving material, cast shadows, damage and contact deformation. Reject or qualify a calmer finish that changes construction, effect, emotion or defining medium.

Read the actual complete lettered chapter at 390px: speaker/tail attribution, reading order, exact text, contrast, line breaks, balloon collision and scrolling reveal. Faces, hands, contact and important environment remain visible. Full image fit and OCR checks do not prove comfortable reading.

Bind every actual attempt and before/after finding to image SHA and actual phone capture. Separate observed, ambiguous and absent relationships; preserve disagreement and exposure. No numeric beauty score, invented reader test, individual owner vote, canon or owner approval.

preflight_caveats: Sixteen panels must carry a compact complete story; scripts should not spend most of the budget teaching combat rules before introducing a reason to care.
Freeze editable exact lettering and space needs before each image. A late wall of dialogue can obscure the best action even when the raster passes review.
New art must stage new story choices and reactions; prior AR compositions may calibrate treatment but cannot silently count as new chapter panels.
Inspect every cast-sheet view and insert before propagation. Contradictory hands or duplicate weapons in a supplemental sheet are foundation risks.
Reconfirm RC versus FL drawing systems: AR RC became smoother/glossier and lost nib hatching; FL retained stronger coarse brush mass. More quieting is not automatically more faithful.
Budget caps are ceilings, not targets. Structural changes and source-only finishing need separate evidence, and no current brief or output is assumed successful.
known_exposure: Prior AR review and inherited AR PIPELINE/RESULTS read as historical failure hypotheses. No new chapter author verdict or new generated image viewed.
